items.html: And it is found that through the Yenika, his three lower Sefirot finish being clarified, and he nurses them and receives them in the secret of Yenika; and then his three last [Sefirot] finish being corrected in him. Therefore what, at the time of the Ibur, was “three last included in three middles” — for they could not be revealed, because he was in his smallness, in the secret of the Ibur, as above — and he was then in the aspect of the small Vav within the Hey; and moreover, at the end of the Vav, the Malchut was in the secret of a step outside. And after he was born, he became the Vav of the Name that comes after the Hey, for he has now come out of her; and what were then his NHY, clothing the HGT while he was in her Ibur — he was born and came out, and complete VAK were made in him.
